  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <base href="/">
  <!--
    Preconnect only to origins this document hits before LCP. Each one occupies a
    connection during the critical window, and Lighthouse warns past four. Measured on
    /crypto/bitcoin/, main frame: imagecodex 135ms (32 requests), fonts.gstatic 329ms
    (blocks text paint). Ordered by value, since browsers work through them in order.

    Removed, all verified against production:
      googletagmanager — no longer eager, loads after `load` now (#5200)
      fonts.googleapis — this document never requests it; the Roboto CSS is inlined at
                         build time. Only the ad iframes fetch it, and not until ~1.8s
      cdn.onesignal    — deliberately held 5s after bootstrap, arrives at ~6.5s
    #5198

    www.clarity.ms is back: #5202 dropped it while Clarity was disabled, and #5310
    re-enabled Clarity. It loads at ~331ms, inside the LCP window, so it qualifies
    under the rule above — three preconnects, still under the four Lighthouse warns at.
  -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://imagecodex.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://www.clarity.ms">
